title: Hold a licence to operate an aircraft on an intrastate air service
what: Operate an aircraft on a regulated intrastate air service only under a licence for that aircraft granted by the Minister, which authorises it between the points or in the area stated.

confidence_note: Quoted from the Open Australian Legal Corpus copy of the version shown (DECISIONS E-118); later changes not checked. Which air services need a licence follows from Part III and the Minister's route licensing; a public vehicle is any vehicle required to be licensed under the Act (s 3), and medical transport flights are exempt (s 43(2)). Reach and framework marks follow the NSW requirement for this family; to check.
